items.title: 经纬：东方织锦
items.prompt:
创作一张具有专业设计工作室水准的东方文化实验性艺术海报。

【展览主题】：____
【中文主标题】：____
【英文主标题】：____
【核心视觉对象】：____
【视觉创意】：____
【主色调】：____
【展览日期及机构】：____
【策展说明】：____
【画幅比例】：9:16

一、整体美学与设计语言

融合 Experimental Typography、Expressive Editorial Design、Contemporary Chinese Graphic Design 与高级艺术出版物美学，兼具东方文化气质、现代字体实验性和强烈的艺术表现力。

以艺术化构图为最高优先级，打破传统海报的区块化布局。先建立具有视觉冲击力的整体构图，再将字体、主体、图形和展览信息自然融入其中，而不是按照固定模板填充内容。

二、核心视觉与字体设计

根据主题选择具有代表性的艺术对象，采用真实摄影、艺术绘画或具有物理可信度的立体表现，突出主体的材质、形态、光影与空间层次。

中文标题采用超大尺度的实验性字体，可使用现代高对比宋体、几何字形、狂草书法或空间立体字形。通过极端尺度对比、局部裁切、错位叠压、负空间与透视关系，让文字成为构图本身。

让主体与字体产生具有创意的结构关系，例如建筑镂空构成汉字、舞者动作延续书法笔势、织锦穿越文字结构、飞鸟羽翼与字形交错。避免简单的图文叠加，强调真实的空间互动与视觉融合。

三、实验性艺术编排

采用大胆的非对称构图、开放式网格和富有方向感的视觉动势。根据主题选择对角线、回旋、纵向延伸、空间透视或负空间构图，形成独特的视觉节奏。

搭配优雅的英文衬线字体，灵活运用旋转、断行、错位、纵向排列与边缘裁切。让中英文、数字和主体轮廓形成丰富的尺度、方向与疏密对比。

允许局部文字高度密集，其他区域保持自然留白。网格隐藏于构图秩序之中，而不是直接表现为规则的信息框。

四、信息密度与自由布局

保留展览日期、策展机构、主题说明、中英文短文及必要的专业注释，但不设置固定的信息区域。让文字沿主体轮廓、字体笔画、运动轨迹和自然负空间错落分布，使信息本身参与艺术构图。

信息丰富但不区块化，复杂但不杂乱。避免机械的顶部标题、中部主体、底部信息栏结构，以及标准化页眉页脚、矩形信息框、固定分栏和过多装饰性细线。

五、色彩与材质

采用成熟、克制而富有对比的艺术配色，突出主体真实的材质特征、自然光影、细腻纹理与高级印刷质感。保持色面饱满干净，细节丰富而有秩序，避免廉价 CGI、随机做旧、过度发光与无意义装饰。

六、最终呈现

不同主题保持统一的艺术指导、实验性字体美学、真实材质与精密中英混排，但每张作品必须拥有独立的构图逻辑与视觉创意。

输出高分辨率的完整艺术海报，远看具有强烈的视觉冲击，近看具有丰富的材质细节、准确的文字和精妙的艺术化排版。

避免模板化布局、过度极简、乱码文字、错误字形和无意义的信息堆砌。

让海报不仅是传达展览信息的媒介，更是一件本身就值得被展览的实验性平面设计作品。

每張獨立選擇兩個或多個不同的 Emoji 或顏文字進行融合，開放探索人物、動物、食物、物件、自然元素與各種情緒。

整組變化來源類別與組合方式，探索 Emoji 與 Emoji、Emoji 與顏文字、多個顏文字等不同搭配，讓顏文字多次參與融合。每張選擇不同組合與心情，減少主體和表達重復。

先確定本張的融合配方，提取各來源最有辨識度的五官、神態、輪廓、動作或字符特徵，將它們融合成一個完整的新表情，表達一種有趣的情緒或狀態。

根據來源自身形態設計結果：臉部表情重點融合五官與神態；帶手勢或全身形態的表情保留有助於識別的身體結構；動物、物件和自然元素保留關鍵外形；顏文字的眼睛、嘴巴、符號或字符排列自然融入新表情。身體、四肢與動作由組合和表達需要決定。

融合結果保持簡潔的表情圖標感，以主體輪廓和關鍵特徵傳達心情，細節適度，縮小後仍清晰可辨。

畫面從上到下展示融合公式：上方用「×」連接所選來源，中間將「＝」旋轉90°，呈現為兩條並排的細竪線，下方展示融合後的新表情。新表情明顯大於來源，是畫面的視覺重點。

公式中的 Emoji 參照 iOS 系統對應表情的外觀，保留容易辨認的造型、顏色、神態與動作。公式中的顏文字以清晰字符原樣呈現，保持所選字符及排列完整。

融合後的新表情採用與 iOS Emoji 協調的視覺風格：造型簡潔圓潤，表情鮮明，色彩飽滿，具有柔和漸變、細膩高光與輕微立體感。人物、動物與物件保留各自適合的形態，整體如同同一套系統表情。

根據新表情的情緒與主體配色，自由選擇協調的低飽和漸變背景，在新表情後方加入柔和的主題色光暈。光暈與主體保持適當的明度或色相差異，讓表情輪廓清楚可辨。

在新表情附近寫一句簡短自然的中文心情短句，準確表達融合後的意思。字體形態與筆畫氣質呼應情緒，文字完整清晰，與表情和公式保持適當間距。

公式符號、顏文字與背景保持足夠對比。畫面疏密協調，留白自然。

竪版 9:16，n=10。每張為獨立單圖，逐張生成，不拼圖。

items.prompt:
VINTAGE TORN-PAPER COLLAGE | PHOTOGRAPHIC ART EDITION

REFERENCE: Use the uploaded photograph as the primary visual source.
ASPECT RATIO: Vertical 3:4.

Transform the photograph into an artistic mixed-media collage poster inspired by vintage travel magazines, handmade paper compositions, and traditional printmaking.

1. Composition & Structure
Preserve the original subject, natural lighting, perspective, horizon, and spatial relationships. Integrate the photograph into an irregular, organically torn-paper shape. Let the torn edges reveal a warm ivory, textured paper background. Make the paper openings asymmetrical, spontaneous, and naturally layered.

2. Mixed-Media Treatment
Combine realistic photography with hand-painted illustrations, simplified black-and-white silhouettes, subtle ink textures, and expressive color blocks. Let the hand-painted elements occupy approximately 30–35% of the composition while keeping the main subject recognizable and photographic.

3. Visual Elements
Extract meaningful details from the original scene, such as roads, trees, rivers, architecture, landscapes, or surrounding objects. Extend selected elements beyond the photographic boundaries using delicate illustrations, vintage cutouts, and contrasting paper fragments. Use a limited palette of warm beige, muted cream, deep charcoal, and one or two rich accent colors.

4. Paper & Texture
Create authentic overlapping paper layers, rough torn edges, subtle shadows, aged paper grain, screen-print imperfections, and slightly faded ink. The composition should feel physically assembled by hand rather than digitally arranged.

5. Typography & Negative Space
Maintain generous areas of empty paper. Add only a tiny, understated English typewriter-style caption if appropriate. Avoid oversized headlines, decorative logos, watermarks, or excessive text.

6. Overall Aesthetic
Achieve the visual character of an independent art magazine, vintage travel editorial, handmade scrapbook, and experimental screen-printed poster. Keep the composition sophisticated, atmospheric, tactile, and visually balanced.

IMPORTANT: Avoid simply placing the original photograph inside a rectangular frame. The photograph must blend organically into the torn-paper composition, with irregular paper boundaries and illustrated elements creating a seamless visual transition. Preserve the identity and essential details of the original subject.

items.prompt:
Transform the uploaded photograph into a premium-quality, museum-grade conceptual art poster that investigates what the photographed subject is symbolically made of, rather than what it is physically made of.
CENTRAL PHILOSOPHY: "Everything we see is made of things we cannot see."
The artwork must reveal the invisible emotional, philosophical, cultural, historical, or existential ingredients that give the photographed subject its meaning.
The final composition must feel like a visual dissection of the subject's hidden identity.
FORMAT: Vertical 50 × 70 cm, exact 5:7 aspect ratio, 300 DPI, target resolution 5906 × 8268 pixels.
1. SUBJECT ANALYSIS — DISCOVER ITS SYMBOLIC INGREDIENTS
First, carefully analyze the uploaded photograph.
Identify the main subject, its defining characteristics, visual relationships, environment, posture, condition, and emotional atmosphere.
Then ask:
"If this subject were not made of physical matter, what invisible things would it be made of?"
Discover three to five meaningful symbolic ingredients that are specifically connected to the photographed subject.
These ingredients may relate to memory, resilience, longing, belonging, contradiction, transformation, time, hope, vulnerability, connection, or other concepts genuinely suggested by the image.
Do not automatically use these example concepts.
Derive the symbolic ingredients independently from the actual photograph.
Avoid obvious, superficial, generic, or interchangeable interpretations.
The chosen symbolic ingredients must reveal something thought-provoking about this particular subject.
2. MAIN COMPOSITION — THE SYMBOLIC ANATOMY
Create a sophisticated abstract composition in which the original photographed subject appears to be constructed from its invisible symbolic ingredients.
Translate each selected ingredient into a distinctive visual form.
For example:
A feeling of resilience might become a geometric structure that remains connected despite visible fractures.
A sense of memory might become overlapping translucent forms that preserve traces of earlier shapes.
A sense of freedom might become an open curve extending beyond an otherwise rigid geometric boundary.
These are conceptual examples, not mandatory visual elements.
Create original geometric interpretations based on the actual photograph and its selected symbolic ingredients.
The final abstract artwork should feel like the subject has been deconstructed into its invisible components and carefully reassembled.
The resulting symbol must remain visually connected to the original subject's defining silhouette, structure, or visual character.
3. UPPER-RIGHT CUTOUT — VISIBLE REALITY
Introduce an elegant sculptural cutout entering diagonally from the upper-right edge.
Through this opening, reveal an authentic, recognizable fragment of the original uploaded photograph.

成年东亚女性，清冷孤傲气质。瓜子脸（下巴尖，额头宽，清冷孤傲），丹凤眼（细长上挑，眼尾飞扬，妩媚冷艳），剑眉（粗直上扬，英气飒爽），薄唇（纤薄精致，清冷克制），尖鼻（鼻尖尖锐，冷艳凌厉）。五官严格匀称，透视关系正确：双眼大小一致对称，两眼间距等于单眼宽度，鼻翼宽度等于眼距，嘴唇宽度等于瞳孔间距，面部中线左右对称。眉心一颗小痣（增加辨识度）。乌黑低髻，简单银簪，素雅淡妆。

侧坐于湖边湿润岩石上，身体微微后仰，双手撑在身后岩石上。双腿向前伸展，垂入浅水中，水面泛起微微涟漪。头部微微抬起，丹凤眼直视镜头，眼神清冷孤傲。

items.prompt:
SECOND WORLD PHOTOGRAPHY | REALITY MEETS IMAGINATION

Transform an ordinary real-world photograph into a creative visual storytelling artwork where reality seamlessly transitions into a whimsical, hand-drawn second world.

COMPOSITION & STRUCTURE

Create a vertically composed artwork divided into two connected sections:

- Upper section: A highly realistic, photorealistic photograph of an everyday scene, such as a city street, modern building, library, park, bridge, landscape, or architectural location. Preserve authentic photography, natural lighting, realistic textures, accurate proportions, and rich environmental details.
- Lower section: Extend the scene into a warm ivory, lightly textured sketchbook-paper surface. Reimagine selected elements of the original photograph as delicate, minimalist black-ink illustrations, creating an imaginative continuation of the real-world environment.

THE SECOND WORLD CONCEPT

Introduce a small, charming hand-drawn human character interacting creatively with the photographed environment. The illustration should create a clever visual illusion, as though the person is painting, building, extending, repairing, or transforming something from the original photograph.

Examples include painting clouds onto a glass building, extending a real street with hand-drawn roads, transforming library stairs into enormous books, or allowing trees, architecture, and other elements to escape their photographic boundaries.

ARTISTIC STYLE

Combine professional architectural photography with delicate minimalist pen-and-ink doodles. Use thin black sketch lines, loose handwritten details, subtle imperfections, and warm cream paper textures. Maintain a sophisticated, editorial art direction with a playful surrealist touch.

STORYTELLING DETAILS

Add one short, poetic handwritten English sentence near the illustration, expressing the imaginative idea behind the scene. Keep the handwriting subtle, natural, and elegant.

IMPORTANT

The transition between photography and illustration must feel visually connected and conceptually meaningful. Avoid random doodles, excessive decorations, cartoon styling, or clutter. The result should feel like a photograph revealing a hidden imaginary world beneath reality.
